Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's data and appends .lcphr extension to encrypted files
Installed through malicious Word documents that download and execute the ransomware executable
Displays a decryptor screen with countdown and payment check
Brute forces the decryption key using encrypted and unencrypted file pairs
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by references to Windows 7 sample pictures and Windows folders)
Attack Vector: Malicious Word documents that download and execute the ransomware executable
